d:
One of Diljit's most iconic anthems! Raat Di Gedi by Diljit Dosanjh — out on Speed Records.
With Diljit Dosanjh's signature style, music by Jatinder Shah and lyrics by Ranbir Singh, Raat Di Gedi became one of the biggest Punjabi hits of its time — a full-attitude anthem still loved everywhere. Starring Diljit Dosanjh & Neeru Bajwa, directed by Arvindr Khaira. Turn it up!
